# industry classification

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:industryClassification`](gmeow-industryClassification.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/industryClassification>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

Relates an organization to an industry-classification identifier — a NAICS, ISIC, or schema.org industry code. The scheme is declared via [`gmeow:identifierScheme`](gmeow-identifierScheme.md) on the [`Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) node. Non-functional: multiple classifications may coexist.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) -> [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md)
